name: Krea 2 Turbo
description: Krea 2 Turbo makes an image from a prompt in 8 steps, 1K to 2K. Krea 2 Community License: https://www.krea.ai/krea-2-licensing

prompt.description: Natural language, not a tag list: Krea recommends natural-language prompts and says long, detailed ones give the best results. Name the medium (a photograph, a digital painting) along with the subject, framing, setting and light. Put any text to render in quotes.

width.description: Krea 2 Turbo generates from 1K to 2K. Multiples of 16.

seed.description: Optional. Leave it out and every run is a new random take. Send a seed only to remake an image exactly: the seed a job used is in its record.

steps.description: Turbo is distilled for 8 steps, the number Krea and ComfyUI both run.

lora_name.description: Optional LoRA file in the node's loras folder. Leave empty and the slot is removed from the graph entirely. Use a LoRA made for Krea 2: its authors train on Krea 2 Raw and run on Turbo.

lora_strength.description: Weight of the first LoRA. The right range is the LoRA author's: some Krea 2 LoRAs want 0.01, sliders run negative, others ask for 3 to 5. Ignored when lora_name is empty.

lora_name_2.description: Second LoRA, chained after the first, for stacking one LoRA on another. Same rules as lora_name.

lora_strength_2.description: Weight of the second LoRA, from its author. Ignored when lora_name_2 is empty.

unet.description: Diffusion model file on the node. ComfyUI recommends the fp8 build for most users.

example.prompt: A lighthouse keeper in a yellow oilcoat climbing the spiral stairs of a stone lighthouse at dusk, lantern in hand, warm light spilling down the steps, cold blue sea visible through a small window.
